examples.title: Example 1: Setting the Navigation Indicator Interaction and Page Turning Effect
examples.description:
In this example, the changeIndex API is used to set the SwiperAnimationMode animation effect to jump to a specified page, and the onScrollStateChanged callback is used to listen for the scrolling state changes.
The onScrollStateChanged event is supported since API version 20.

examples.title: Example 2: Implementing a Digit Indicator
examples.description: This example uses the DigitIndicator API to implement a digit-style indicator.

examples.title: Example 3: Setting the Page Turning by Group
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement the group-based page turning effect using the displayCount attribute.

examples.title: Example 4: Customizing the Page Transition Animation
examples.description: This example presents how to implement a custom page transition animation for the Swiper component through the customContentTransition API.

examples.title: Example 5: Configuring Overflow for the Dot-Style Indicator
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to implement an animation for the overflow effect when the number of navigation dots exceeds the limit set through the maxDisplayCount property of the DotIndicator API.

examples.title: Example 6: Preloading Child Nodes
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the preloadItems API to preload specified child nodes.

examples.title: Example 7: Implementing Synchronized Switching Between the Tabs and Swiper Components
examples.description: This example associates Tabs with the Swiper component through the onSelected API.

examples.title: Example 8: Intercepting the Scrolling Behavior
examples.description: This example demonstrates how to use the onContentWillScroll event to allow only forward scrolling and intercept backward scrolling.

examples.title: Example 9: Using the space and bottom APIs on the Navigation Indicator
examples.description: This example uses the bottom and space APIs to achieve zero spacing control between the dot-style navigation indicators and the bottom, as well as spacing control between navigation indicators.

examples.title: Example 10: Displaying the Number of Elements Displayed in the Swiper Component Based on Breakpoints
examples.description:
This example demonstrates how to set the number of elements displayed in the Swiper viewport based on breakpoints.
Since API version 22, the displaycount API is added to set the number of elements displayed in the Swiper viewport.

examples.title: Example 11: Implementing Drag Simulation Using the Swiper Component
examples.description:
This example shows how to implement drag simulation using the Swiper component. If the component itself does not respond to the drag event, the child component Column invokes the Swiper API based on the touch event information to implement a similar effect to that of dragging.
Since API version 23, the startFakeDrag, fakeDragBy, stopFakeDrag, and isFakeDragging APIs are added to implement drag simulation.
